agent_notes.scanner_defect_lowercase_in_target: batch_scan.py line 147 tests re.search(token.lower(), target_lower) where target_lower is the WHOLE file lowercased, so the token always matches its own occurrence. lowercase_in_target is therefore true for all 125 members in this scan and carries no information. I did not apply the brief's 'if it is true, recommend no_rule' rule mechanically -- that would have no_rule'd every member. I recomputed the real signal (does a genuinely lowercase spelling of the token exist elsewhere in the target) and report it per member as lowercase_in_target_recomputed. 27 of 125 tokens are genuinely lowercase-colliding; for those I say so in the rationale. Recommend the orchestrator fix batch_scan.py before wave 2.
agent_notes.auto_dismiss_policy: Applied the GM's rule strictly: count == 1 AND kind == ordinary_words. I additionally declined to dismiss two members that met the letter of the rule but carried evidence the GM needs -- 'understand' (its sibling span reveals a hidden Soma at line 1741) and several out-of-game proper nouns (Gale, Baracas, Box Shadow Heart, Dread Pirate Robert, Curse Busters, Original Sin) which are correctly spelled but not campaign canon.
agent_notes.false_residual_policy: Suppressed only runs whose embedded name is ALREADY CORRECT and where the scanner flagged the run because it cannot split it: 'The Harpers', 'Court Harbin Master', 'Mendenhall'.
